investigation_scope: Comprehensive feasibility survey of public thoracic imaging repositories for paired 2D-to-3D external reconstruction validation

candidate_datasets.citation: Johnson et al., Sci Data 2019; PhysioNet
candidate_datasets.licensing: PhysioNet Credentialed Data Use Agreement (Requires human subjects research ethics training)
candidate_datasets.acquisition_demographics: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, MA; Emergency/ICU adult cohort (377,110 radiographs)
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: Lacks paired 3D thoracic CT volumes and 3D lung segmentations for the imaged radiographs.

candidate_datasets.citation: Irvin et al., AAAI 2019; Stanford ML Group
candidate_datasets.licensing: Stanford University School of Medicine Research License
candidate_datasets.acquisition_demographics: Stanford Hospital, adult inpatient and outpatient studies (224,316 radiographs)
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: Pure radiograph repository; completely lacks 3D CT volumes and ground-truth 3D anatomical surfaces.

candidate_datasets.full_name: PadChest: A Large Chest X-Ray Image Dataset with Multi-Label Annotated Reports
candidate_datasets.citation: Bustos et al., Med Image Anal 2020; Univ. Alicante
candidate_datasets.acquisition_demographics: Hospital San Juan de Alicante, Spain; clinical PACS archive (160,000+ radiographs)
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: No corresponding 3D volumetric CT scans are released or linked to the radiographic studies.

candidate_datasets.citation: Wang et al., IEEE CVPR 2017; NIH Clinical Center
candidate_datasets.acquisition_demographics: NIH Clinical Center, Bethesda, MD (112,120 frontal radiographs only)
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: Contains exclusively frontal (PA/AP) views (0 lateral views) and no paired 3D CT volumes.

candidate_datasets.full_name: LIDC-IDRI / LUNA16 Thoracic CT Nodule & Anatomy Benchmark
candidate_datasets.citation: Armato et al., Med Phys 2011; Setio et al., Med Image Anal 2017
candidate_datasets.acquisition_demographics: 7 academic imaging centers (888 volumetric thoracic CT scans)
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: Provides 3D CT volumes and anatomical segmentations, but contains ZERO clinical radiographs. Radiographs can only be digitally synthesized (DRRs), precluding real clinical radiograph external validation.

candidate_datasets.full_name: RibFrac: Benchmarking Rib Fracture Detection in Thoracic CT
candidate_datasets.acquisition_demographics: Trauma center CT scans (500 thoracic CTs)
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: Lacks radiographs and lacks lung parenchyma/surface segmentations (rib annotations only).

candidate_datasets.citation: Vayá et al., Med Image Anal 2020; CSIC / Generalitat Valenciana
candidate_datasets.blocking_rationale: Temporal discordance: radiographs and CTs were acquired at disparate clinical encounters (days/weeks apart). Dynamic lung volume changes during acute COVID make surface comparison anatomically invalid. Lateral radiographs and standardized 3D surface meshes are absent.

summary.scientific_conclusion: No publicly accessible clinical thoracic imaging repository worldwide provides simultaneous real clinical dual-view (frontal + lateral) chest radiographs with paired volumetric 3D CT lung surface segmentations. External validation of dual-view 3D lung surface reconstruction on real clinical radiographs is therefore structurally BLOCKED by the absence of open clinical paired datasets in medical literature.

governance_mandate: LungVision AI adheres to Gravitas Reliability Invariant 6: Say what you can't verify. We explicitly refuse to fabricate external paired datasets or substitute 2D pathology classification benchmarks as proxies for 3D anatomical surface reconstruction.
